# Representations of BSON corpus cases the BSON codec does not pass, each
# with the class of its refusal, which the book's BSON page states:
# array-key and regex-options for degenerate BSON and Extended JSON the
# codec refuses rather than normalize; non-canonical-decimal128 for
# decimal128 bits IEEE 754 reads as zero; write-nan for NaNs Extended JSON
# writes as the one NaN it has; decimal-representation for $numberDecimal
# strings decimal128 holds only by clamping or rounding.
# Columns: case (file#section#index#representation), class.
